title: EU–China WTO2000 comparison: evidence and reading register

sources.title: 中国加入世界贸易组织谈判文件资料选编：综合卷①（总第1册）, 中国加入世界贸易组织谈判历程, EU2000 subsection
sources.author_or_institution: 商务部世界贸易组织司编; 索必成主编; 中国商务出版社
sources.source_type: Later official documentary history with selected contemporary facsimiles
sources.read_scope: Complete selected subsection printed 370–385/PDF 405–420 read in extraction and/or images. Consequential scans visually read PDF 405–406,409–420. PDF 407–408 text read; corrupted numeral font means exact dates used from rendered pages or cross-checked records. February 23 technical package facsimile printed 374–375/PDF 409–410; March 30 Chinese English proposal p 378/PDF 413; EU March 30 package editorial transcription pp 379–380/PDF 414–415; May English compromise first page p 382/PDF 417. No claim to read complete 603-page volume.
sources.evidentiary_use: Dated demand reductions, package alternatives and reservations, February non-visit, March unsuccessful senior intervention, May reported coordination and requests for authority.
sources.limits: Narrative published 13 years later; editorial selection and underlying minutes not exposed. February tariff/procurement annexes absent; March Chinese package reproduced only first page ending mid-paragraph; May second page explicitly referenced but absent. May facsimile caption dates only month; no exact delivery day. Handwritten February marks unattributed, not proof of acceptance.
sources.source_dependence: All narration and facsimiles are within one official collection; facsimiles improve textual specificity, not an extra independent witness. Existing source family CN-WTO-G1.

facsimile_units.status: EU technical proposal; annexes missing; handwritten marks unattributed
Chinese comprehensive proposal first page only
EU package editorial Chinese transcription, not facsimile
EU outline for compromise first page; conditional on absent second page

sources.title: COM(2001)517: proposal establishing Community position on China WTO accession, full explanatory memorandum
sources.publication_date: 2001-09-19 (adoption per EUR-Lex procedure); later OJ publication 2002-02-26
sources.source_type: Official explanatory memorandum and proposed decision
sources.read_scope: All 56 numbered explanatory paragraphs, proposed decision recitals/article and annex read. Separate commission-2001-517.pdf contains only two OJ pages of proposal/annex, not the full memorandum.
sources.evidentiary_use: Commission account of EU achievements, selected tariff basket, licenses outside accession terms, schedule interpretation, eventual institutional completion.
sources.limits: Public advocacy and final-package summary, not signed May bilateral annex. Para 42 corporate RMB3 years conflicts with final 2; para 35 non-life business scope 1 year conflicts with final 2; para 41 chain summary omits sensitive-product exception. Para 29 applied-rate cuts cannot measure incremental EU concession.
sources.source_dependence: Institutional EU source; may incorporate later multilateral results. Press and Lapres may depend on earlier versions of EU summaries.
sources.date_note: EUR-Lex procedure page labels Commission adoption 19 September 2001; separate OJ proposal publication says submitted by Commission 19 October 2001. These metadata labels are not treated as two negotiation events.

sources.title: WT/ACC/CHN/49/Add.2, Schedule CLII, Part II—Schedule of Specific Commitments on Services
sources.read_scope: PDF/printed pages 1–5,19–20,25–27,30–35 read. Rendered pp 26,30,34–35 visually inspected; other cited pages text read. Legal section begins p 5; continuation and complete 55-page schedule not audited.
sources.evidentiary_use: Final ownership/phase-in/scope/geography terms; horizontal grandfathering p 3 and insurance note 8 p 30.
sources.limits: Final 2001 terms cannot establish bilateral offer sequence or uniquely allocate gains to EU. No actual implementation inferred. Protocol Annex 2 a referenced by retail exception not fully reproduced/audited here.
sources.source_dependence: Primary final text independent of public summaries, but consolidates bilateral/multilateral bargains.

sources.title: The EU-China WTO Deal Compared, The China Business Review, July–August 2000
sources.source_type: Contemporary practitioner analysis in business journal
sources.read_scope: Complete article pp 8,10–12,14 read; pages 9/13 are advertisements. Two-page comparison table pp 10–11 visually inspected. Entire issue not read.
sources.evidentiary_use: Contemporary comparisons and caveats; business-interest hypotheses; US mobile five-year equity comparison and wine 20 baseline as reported claims.
sources.limits: Not peer-reviewed research or participant minutes. Geography table US3 years conflicts with White House 5; scope table EU2 years conflicts with final life 3; seven licenses described at accession rather than before. Legal practice and state-trading directions overcompressed; not relied on as definitive legal interpretation. Industrial endpoint 10.6 differs from Commission 10.9.
sources.source_dependence: Based on public terms/industry reactions; table author credit is not proof of separate access to signed annexes.

sources.title: Summary of US–China Bilateral WTO Agreement
sources.read_scope: Complete substantive web summary read, including agriculture, services, safeguards and textiles. Root independently preserved same source as WTO-M03.
sources.evidentiary_use: Version-specific US baseline: life 50/partner choice, insurance 5-year geographic and scope timetable, corporate RMB2/individual 5.
sources.limits: Not full signed bilateral annex; does not supply exact timetable to 49 mobile equity. Different public summaries conflict.
sources.source_dependence: Same document as WTO-M03; not a new independent corroborator.

sources.title: General Affairs Council, Luxembourg: written answer reporting April 10–11 meeting
sources.author_or_institution: UK Foreign and Commonwealth Office, parliamentary answer
sources.source_type: Official national report of EU Council proceedings
sources.read_scope: China/WTO paragraph 7 read; other agenda items not substantively audited.
sources.evidentiary_use: Council support for Lamy approach after unsuccessful March round, call for reciprocal flexibility.
sources.limits: Not original Council minutes or confidential Article 133 mandate. Public approval cannot date private authorization.
sources.source_dependence: British official description of Council; independent institution from Chinese history, but limited to public account.

sources.title: 朱镕基会见丹麦首相拉斯穆森
sources.read_scope: Complete short meeting account read online; event date distinguished from page date.
sources.evidentiary_use: Zhu seeks early European agreement and hopes EU not last; Rasmussen promises efforts within EU.
sources.limits: Stated preference, not binding deadline or actual concession.
sources.source_dependence: Separate public meeting record; later Chinese reports may repeat it.

sources.title: 中欧WTO谈判北京再开锣
sources.author_or_institution: 余东晖, China News Service, reproduced by Sina
sources.evidentiary_use: May 15 opening and account of preceding technical rounds; publicly stated positions.
sources.limits: Reporter observation of sessions and attributed remarks; no confidential draft access established.
sources.source_dependence: Sina is host/republication, not second witness.

sources.title: 入世谈判焦急等待 记者扎堆成一景
sources.author_or_institution: 刘珲, 北京晨报, reproduced by Sina
sources.read_scope: Complete article read online, including uncertainty and spokesman attribution.
sources.evidentiary_use: Parallel political/technical tracks; uncertain timing observed by reporters waiting outside.
sources.limits: Rumors and hotel booking not accepted as confirmed deadline.
sources.source_dependence: Independent reporting venue; spokesperson statements still institutional claims.

sources.title: EU–China summit background note, MEMO/00/67
sources.read_scope: All 4 pages read in extraction; WTO passages pp 1–2 used.
sources.evidentiary_use: Remaining 5 new licenses and 2 sub-branches; seven weeks of multilateral work June/July/September; wider ministries; clarification-versus-new-demand dispute.
sources.limits: EU account of progress and demands, not all parties agreed description. Heading extraction font imperfect; body legible. Chinese accusation is presented through Commission: beyond normal accession requirements, not specifically beyond a bilateral undertaking.
sources.source_dependence: Same institutional source family as Commission 2001 memo, different date and purpose.

sources.title: USTR release 01-38: United States and China reach agreement on outstanding issues for WTO accession
sources.author_or_institution: Office of the US Trade Representative; State Department Washington File mirror
sources.source_type: Contemporary official release preserved on private archive
sources.read_scope: Complete substantive release read through web tool, including agriculture, trading rights, insurance and distribution subheads. Raw HTML download returned 403; no preserved original file.
sources.evidentiary_use: June 4–8 Shanghai talks and continuing 2001 disagreement/clarification after May 2000.
sources.limits: US allegations about 2000 draft/regulatory changes not independently checked against those documents. Release says reinsurance 0 after 5 years while final schedule p 30 gives 4; no inference of later reversal.
sources.source_dependence: Original US official account via private mirror, not independent journalistic corroboration.

sources.title: China poised for membership of WTO
sources.read_scope: Substantive article text displayed online read; page HTML preserved. No claim to inspect other linked articles.
sources.evidentiary_use: Public deal announcement and reported mobile US5/EU3 phase-in comparison.
sources.limits: Press account does not disclose signed annex; article contains incidental obvious copy errors (EU vs WTO wording); not propagated.
sources.source_dependence: Named reporter; commercial terms may derive EU public briefing also used by Lapres.

sources.title: 我亲历的加入WTO金融部门谈判, in 中国“入世”谈判风云录
sources.author_or_institution: 邓红国; 张向晨、索必成主编; 人民出版社
sources.read_scope: This pass read printed 295/PDF 308 in full extraction, plus existing complete-chapter reading audit wto-financial-participant-note.md. Earlier audit read chapter printed 284–315; do not count as new full reread.
sources.evidentiary_use: Portugal’s Zhuhai 3-to 1 request, PBOC authorization, participant judgment of minor concession; MFN/European-interest framing.
sources.limits: Retrospective commemorative contribution. Initial 3-year offer, Portuguese request and approval not recovered independently. Broad rejection-of-US-baseline statement differs from Beseler January account.
sources.source_dependence: Participant source distinct from 2013 history but not necessarily independent of earlier official narratives.

sources.title: China’s Accession to the WTO: The Services Dimension, Policy Research Working Paper 2932
sources.read_scope: Complete narrative body PDF 5–25/printed 2–22 and title/abstract read; table 2 PDF 26–30 text read. Figure 1/PDF 7 and table 1/PDF 8 plus table 2 financial/distribution pp 28–29 visually inspected. Annex table PDF 31 text inspected; dense PDF 32 appendix and PDF 33 final figure not visually audited. Whole-paper visual/table audit not claimed.
sources.evidentiary_use: Commitments versus actual market access; geography and first-mover mechanisms; ownership incentives; grandfathering ambiguities and domestic regulation.
sources.limits: Not participant evidence of May meetings; author’s views not World Bank institutional position. Comparisons use non-identical commitment vintages; table 1 explicitly undercounts others’ later finance/telecom commitments. FT/Inside US Trade allegations cited in paper not independently read.
sources.source_dependence: Final schedules are common input; analysis distinct from evidence of their negotiation. Related 2003 journal and 2004 chapter versions not read or counted separately.

sources.title: Exchange of Letters initialled 19 May 2000 amending EC–China MFA/non-MFA textile agreements
sources.read_scope: Council letter paragraphs 1–8, AnnexI prose and AnnexII articles 1–10 read; duplicate Chinese acceptance letter, remainder of AnnexII and ProtocolA not fully audited. HTML omits AnnexI category table; no product-level schedule claim.
sources.evidentiary_use: EU phase-out/notification obligations, automatic extension if accession after 2000, reciprocal provisional application and Chinese export administration.
sources.limits: Related textile instrument, not full general WTO bilateral agreement. AnnexI conditions on silk state-trading progress remain; no unconditional product-by-product phase-out assertion.
sources.source_dependence: Actual published instrument; Council signing decision is separate procedural act, not independent evidence of bargains.

sources.title: Council Decision 2000/787/EC on signing and provisional application of textile exchange of letters
sources.read_scope: Full recitals, articles 1–3, signature and footnote read.
sources.evidentiary_use: Initialling vs signing approval vs provisional application (November 24), subject to reciprocity.
sources.limits: Does not reproduce a general accession mandate or prove balance of concessions.
sources.source_dependence: Implements EWT-15, not a second independent agreement.

sources.title: European Parliament legislative resolution on Community position for China WTO accession, A5-0366/2001
sources.read_scope: Complete China resolution at printed OJ C112 E/313, PDF page 6 of 6: title, consultation basis, all recitals, operative 1–2. Preceding Turkey resolution not audited. Earlier ep-resolution-2001.html acquisition is site shell, not preserved substantive resolution.
sources.evidentiary_use: Parliament approves Community position October 25, distinct from bilateral signature and final accession.
sources.limits: Not rapporteur’s explanatory report; A5-0366 full report remains unacquired.
sources.source_dependence: Official parliamentary act, not another negotiating narrative.

sources.title: 欧盟在中美欧经贸大三角中的“借力型战略”, 欧洲观察2021年第4期/总184期
sources.source_type: Scholarly essay in accessible institutional reprint
sources.read_scope: Complete selected WTO section printed 10–13/PDF 11–14; preceding 1979 passage printed 9/PDF 10 read; introduction partly screened. Full article printed 2–23 not claimed read. Colophon identifies内部交流刊物. Author footnote on printed 2/PDF 3 subsequently read: original article appeared in 欧洲研究2021年第3期,pp 17–42; reprint says occasional changes made.
sources.evidentiary_use: Alternative hypothesis of EU using US pressure/PNTR window to advance differentiated interests.
sources.limits: Accessible version is institutional reprint in internally circulated 欧洲观察; author footnote identifies original 欧洲研究2021 no 3 pp 17–42, with occasional changes. Original journal version not acquired or double-counted. Lamy, Li Lanqing and Algieri works cited but not acquired here; apparent House/Senate imprecision not propagated.
sources.source_dependence: Explicit reliance on Li Lanqing 2008 p 335, Lamy translated memoir 2004 withoutpages, Algieri CQ169 pp 74–75 and FT1999. Not independent verification of those underlying accounts.

sources.title: 拉米认为加入WTO将为中国改革提供新动力
sources.author_or_institution: 余东晖, China News Service, reproduced by Sina
sources.read_scope: Complete reported speech text read, including reform hopes, thanks to Brittan/Beseler, completion/implementation and 25 thanniversary remarks.
sources.evidentiary_use: Lamy’s public account of reciprocal gains and expected reform stimulus.
sources.limits: Chinese-language reported全文; translator unidentified, English EU transcript not independently checked. Public advocacy does not establish political liberalization outcomes.
sources.source_dependence: Same reporter/agency family as EWT-08; speech not private minutes.

preservation_policy: Full copyrighted works, HTML and OCR are outside Git. Hashes concern acquired bytes, not authentication of each claim. Web-read-only source EWT-11 has no preserved original. Duplicate versions do not count as independent witnesses.

quality_flags: EWT-02 corporate RMB3-year and non-life business-scope 1-year summaries conflict with final 2-year provisions.
EWT-04 insurance geography US3-year comparison differs from EWT-05 US5-year version.
Deng’s general statement that EU rejected US agreement as basis differs from Beseler January account; baseline versus sufficiency may partly reconcile.
Document language China confirms inside an EU proposal does not prove assent; unassigned manuscript ticks do not establish acceptance.
June 2001 USTR reinsurance timetable differs from final schedule; no change narrative inferred without intervening texts.

independent_review.status: Completed 2026-09-15. Reviewer visually inspected Chinese May chronology and final WTO retail/banking pages, checked Commission/MEMO/Parliament passages, read all 23 move records and consequential revised case passages. Corrections incorporated on EU mandate timing, coordination inference, Commission non-life scope, final foreign-majority exception, MEMO attribution and Parliament link. Reviewer reported no remaining substantive correction. Not external expert review or full independent reread of every source.
